completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11612_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Public Works and Highways, an additional district engineering office for the Third Legislative District of the Province of Zamboanga del Norte. It shall be known as the Fourth District Engineering Office and shall be located in the Municipality of Siocon, Province of Zamboanga del Norte.
The Fourth District Engineering Office shall serve the municipalities of Baliguian, Siraway, Siocon, and Sibuco, all within the Third Legislative District of the Province of Zamboanga del Norte.

The Secretary of the Department of Public Works and Highways shall include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Fourth District Engineering Office in the Province of Zamboanga del Norte, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
